connections.notes: Location 11 sits on the north bank of the river near the R1 river waypoint. The river passes adjacent to 11, allowing water-based access between them.
Location 12 is directly south of 11. They appear to be two alcoves along the same passage or connected by a visible open corridor running north-south between them.
A passage appears to lead south from the 11/12 alcove area down into room 13 (The Riven Hall). There is a visible corridor connecting these areas.

not_connected.reason: Location 10 is a dead-end river tunnel to the west. While somewhat nearby, there is no visible passage or doorway connecting 10 directly to 11. They are separated by solid walls and cave structure.
Location 14 is on the far east side across the river. No direct passage connects 11 to 14; they are separated by the river and solid walls with no visible opening.
Location 4A (Great Bronze Doors) is far to the south in the central hall area. No direct passage connects it to 11; multiple rooms and corridors lie between them.
Location 7 (Western Corridor) is well to the south-southwest. No direct passage connects it to 11; they are separated by multiple intervening rooms and walls.
Location 9 (Northern Corridor) is to the south of 11. While in the same general area, the map shows walls separating them with no visible direct opening between 9 and 11.
J3 (Trapped Fork) is far to the south-southwest. No direct connection visible; multiple rooms and corridors separate them.
R2 is a river waypoint to the east. The river does not appear to directly connect to location 11 at this point; R1 is the closer river access point for 11.
R3 is further east along the river. No direct river or passage connection to 11 is visible at this point.
R4 is far to the east-southeast along the river. No connection to 11.
R5 is the river exit far to the south. No connection to 11.
